description: The web UI verification gate treats a new browser console error as a hard failure, even when every visual assertion passed.
failure_mode: Model reports the verify-ui flow as passed because the visible UI state matched, ignoring a new JS exception or failed resource load in the console.
prompt: During the web UI verification gate (Phase 2.45), a verify-ui flow's step 3 passes its visual assertion (the expected element is present), but the browser console shows a new error that was not there before step 3. The mode is strict. What is the flow's status and what happens to feature-validate? End your answer with a single ```json fenced block containing exactly this object, with one value chosen for each field: {"flow_status": "passed" | "failed", "validation_status": "passed" | "failed", "pr_created": true | false}

assertions.description: a new console error fails the flow
